package main

import (
	"errors"
	"os"

	"github.com/spf13/cobra"
	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/cue"
)

type validateCommand struct {
	issueExitCode int
	format        string
}

func newValidateCommand() *cobra.Command {
	v := &validateCommand{}

	cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:          "validate",
		Short:        "Validate a list of flipt features.yaml files",
		Run:          v.run,
		Hidden:       true,
		SilenceUsage: true,
	}

	cmd.Flags().IntVar(&v.issueExitCode, "issue-exit-code", 1, "Exit code to use when issues are found")

	cmd.Flags().StringVarP(
		&v.format,
		"format", "F",
		"text",
		"output format",
	)

	return cmd
}

func (v *validateCommand) run(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) {
	if err := cue.ValidateFiles(os.Stdout, args, v.format); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, cue.ErrValidationFailed) {
			os.Exit(v.issueExitCode)
		}
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

package cue

import (
	\"bytes\"
	\"encoding/json\"
	\"errors\"
	\"os\"
	\"path/filepath\"
	\"strings\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

const invalidFeatures = "'`namespace: default
flags:
- key: first
  name: First
  ey: typo
  nabled: true
  variants: []
  rules:
  - segment: users
    rank: 1
    distributions:
    - variant: blue
      rollout: 110
- key: second
  name: Second
  escription: typo
  variants: []
  rules: []
segments: []
`

func TestFeaturesValidatorReportsEachFieldAtItsYAMLPosition(t *testing.T) {
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	result, err := validator.Validate("features.yaml", []byte(invalidFeatures))
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 4)

	want := map[string]Location{
		"flags.0.ey":                            {File: "features.yaml", Line: 5, Column: 3},
		"flags.0.nabled":                        {File: "features.yaml", Line: 6, Column: 3},
		"flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout": {File: "features.yaml", Line: 13, Column: 16},
		"flags.1.escription":                   {File: "features.yaml", Line: 16, Column: 3},
	}
	for _, issue := range result.Errors {
		require.Equal(t, want[issue.Path], issue.Location, issue.Path)
		require.NotEmpty(t, issue.Message)
		if strings.HasSuffix(issue.Path, ".rollout") {
			require.Contains(t, issue.Message, "<=100")
		} else {
			require.Contains(t, issue.Message, "field not allowed")
		}
	}
}

func TestValidateFilesJSONUsesWriterAndIncludesAllErrors(t *testing.T) {
	file := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "features.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(file, []byte(invalidFeatures), 0600))
	var out bytes.Buffer
	err := ValidateFiles(&out, []string{file}, "json")
	require.True(t, errors.Is(err, ErrValidationFailed))
	var result Result
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &result))
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 4)
	require.Equal(t, file, result.Errors[0].Location.File)
}

func TestValidateFilesTextShowsPathAndPosition(t *testing.T) {
	file := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "features.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(file, []byte(invalidFeatures), 0600))
	var out bytes.Buffer
	require.ErrorIs(t, ValidateFiles(&out, []string{file}, "text"), ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Contains(t, out.String(), file+":5:3: flags.0.ey: field not allowed")
	require.Contains(t, out.String(), file+":13:16: flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout:")
}

func TestFeaturesValidatorReportsMalformedYAML(t *testing.T) {
	validator, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := validator.Validate("broken.yaml", []byte("flags: ['"\\n\"))
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.NotEmpty(t, result.Errors)
	require.Equal(t, \"broken.yaml\", result.Errors[0].Location.File)
}
